09001.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge near New Canaan had its wettest month in July, at 11.06 inches. That came after 11 days in a row with nothing in the gauge, Jul 8 to Jul 18. Then the biggest single day hit Jul 22 with 4.64 inches. On the days both years reported, this year sits 14.52 inches more than 2025.

09003.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Hartford-Bradley International Airport had its wettest month in July with 8.66 inches. That same July also held the longest dry stretch, 10 days in a row with nothing in the gauge from Jul 8 to Jul 17. The biggest single day came Aug 3 with 3.59 inches. The year sits 0.21 inches less than last year at this point.

09011.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge less than a mile north of Griswold had a wet September, with 8.75 inches for the month. A good share of that came on Sep 14, when the gauge took 4.25 inches, its biggest one-day reading of the year. The longest dry stretch ran 10 days, Jan 28 to Feb 6. On the days both years reported, this year is 6.31 inches more than 2025.

09013.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 2.7 miles southeast of Willington had 41.96 inches, 1.25 inches more than a usual year. July was the wettest month at 7.68 inches, even with 10 days in a row of nothing in the gauge from Jul 9 to Jul 18. The biggest single day came Sep 27 with 2.07 inches. That puts this year 3.19 inches ahead of last year to the same day.
